test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements :**

No crow is a monkey.

All monkeys are turtles.

No turtle is a snail.

**Conclusions :**

I. Some snails being crows is a possibility.

II. No turtle is a crow.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows
Both conclusions I and Il follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible venn diagram has been shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f620f79610290d5b56cdf53072a2bd152a5ca5ed9b4b1d3d320aafbc5d19e68.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some snails being crows is a possibility → **Follows** (Because it is not definite, but it is possible).

II. No turtle is a crow → **Not Follows** (Because it is not definite, but it is possible).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows"**.
